openings.claim: Current-assignment lookup may omit historical courses, generating checking and replacement demand.
openings.discriminator: Changing only assignment changes incumbent membership; week-specific lookup preserves intended membership. Unchanged inclusion weakens causality.
openings.fit: Private staging; compatible CSV, isolation and concurrent-entry checks.
openings.probe: Agree intended sets independently; replay fabricated reassignments under both lookups with cross-center decoys; estimate history availability and deployment effort.
openings.uncertainty: Association is unproven; authoritative history, intended membership and deployment feasibility remain uncertain.

openings.claim: Renames may cause selection loss or apparent omissions that regenerate replacement demand; stale timetables offer another explanation.
openings.discriminator: Absent internal IDs indicate selection loss; present IDs flagged absent indicate recognition failure; timetable disagreement needs independent membership. Mapping should reduce false reports while preserving missing-course detection.
openings.fit: Private authorized workspaces; unchanged CSV; uninterrupted attendance.
openings.probe: Counterbalance fabricated unchanged, renamed and missing courses, with/without companion name mapping, across two short sessions. Inspect IDs; observe spreadsheet actions, checking/import time, omission decisions and replacement requests.
openings.uncertainty: Identity inspection and accurate mappings are assumed. Mappings cannot settle splits or stale timetables; unchanged errors weaken recognition causality.
